label: SLEEP TIP
hook: Your bedroom might be too warm
lines: Most people sleep best in a cool room.
Aim for roughly 16-20 °C (65-68 °F).
scene: A serene open-air terrace of a luxury villa at blue hour, a low daybed with soft white linen and a light blanket, a gentle evening breeze moving sheer curtains, cool blue dusk sky with the first stars, a few warm lanterns, calm sea in the distance, no people.

sources.title: Sleep Foundation – Best Temperature for Sleep

label: SLEEP TIP
lines: In one study, caffeine 6 hours before bed
cut sleep by more than an hour.
Try your last coffee by early afternoon.
scene: An elegant espresso cup on a stone table in a sunny Mediterranean garden in the early afternoon, olive trees and lemon trees, soft dappled light, a calm sea view in the background, no people.

sources.title: American Academy of Sleep Medicine – Late afternoon and early evening caffeine can disrupt sleep

label: RELAX TIP
hook: Try this when your mind races
lines: Box breathing: in for 4 seconds,
hold for 4, out for 4, hold for 4.
Repeat a few rounds and let go.
scene: A tranquil outdoor spa pool at dusk surrounded by smooth stones, bamboo and soft candlelight, light steam over the water, warm golden glow against a deep blue evening sky, no people.

label: SLEEP TIP
hook: The one-hour rule for better sleep
lines: Put phones and tablets away
about an hour before bed.
Their light can make it harder to fall asleep.
scene: A cozy outdoor reading nook on a garden terrace at night, a soft armchair with a knitted throw, a warm lantern and an open paper book, starry sky above, calm and dim, no screens, no people.

sources.title: NHS Every Mind Matters – How to fall asleep faster and sleep better

label: SLEEP TIP
lines: Going to bed and getting up at similar times
helps your body know when it is time to sleep.
Yes, even on weekends.
scene: A peaceful lakeside garden at sunrise, soft pink and golden morning light over still water, a wooden jetty and gentle mist, calm and fresh, no people.

sources.title: NHS Every Mind Matters – How to fall asleep faster and sleep better

label: SLEEP TIP
lines: Get up and do something calm,
like reading or quiet music.
Go back to bed when you feel sleepy.
scene: A quiet balcony of a seaside villa under a full moon, a soft lounge chair with a blanket, a cup of herbal tea on a small table, moonlight on the calm sea, deep blue night with warm candle glow, no people.

sources.title: NHS Every Mind Matters – How to fall asleep faster and sleep better

label: DOLCE VITA
lines: About 350 m above the Amalfi Coast.
Villa Cimbrone's Terrace of the Infinite.
A music festival every summer since 1953.
scene: An elegant woman in a flowing evening dress standing at a marble balustrade with classical busts on a clifftop garden terrace high above the Amalfi Coast at sunset, the sea far below, warm golden light.

label: DOLCE VITA
lines: A village on the eastern shore of Lake Como.
Villa Monastero: gardens by the water.
Castello di Vezio watches from above.
scene: An elegant woman in an evening dress at a candlelit table on a lakeside terrace in a colorful village on Lake Como at sunset, mountains and calm water behind her, warm afterglow.

label: DOLCE VITA
lines: Pastel houses cascade down limestone cliffs.
Santa Maria Assunta has a majolica-tiled dome.
Spiaggia Grande sits at the foot of the town.
scene: An elegant woman in a summer evening dress on a cliffside terrace overlooking pastel houses stacked down the hillside to the sea and a church with a tiled dome, Amalfi Coast at golden hour.

label: DOLCE VITA
lines: Bellagio sits where the lake's branches meet.
Villa Melzi has gardens along the water.
Flaubert wrote: one could live and die here.
scene: An elegant woman in an evening gown walking along a lakeside garden promenade with cypress trees and an old villa on Lake Como at dusk, mountains across the water, soft warm light.
